'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2014–present)|Yemeni Civil War]], [[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
**The [[Houthis]] say they have hit [[King Khalid Air Base]], near the city of [[Khamis Mushait]], in [[Saudi Arabia]], with [[explosive]] [[unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drone]]s. There is no immediate comment from the [[Saudi government]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/yemens-houthis-say-they-have-hit-saudi-arabias-king-khalid-air-base-2021-04-17/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Death and funeral of Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh]]
**The official funeral service takes place for [[Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh|Prince Philip]], [[Prince consort#United Kingdom|prince consort]] of the [[United Kingdom]] to [[Elizabeth II]]. The Duke's body is led in a limited procession to [[St George's Chapel, Windsor Castle|St. George's Chapel]], [[Windsor Castle]], for interment in the Royal Vault. [https://www.msn.com/en-my/news/world/funeral-to-praise-philip-s-courage-and-support-for-queen/ar-BB1fKsDA?ocid=uxbndlbing (AP on MSN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Seven people are killed and five are rescued after a Mil Mi-17 crashes near [[Megantoni District, La Convención province]], [[Peru]]. [https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/249872 (Aviation Safety Network)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] reports a record 234,692 new confirmed cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 14.52 million. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/indias-covid-19-tally-over-14-52-million-with-234-692-fresh-infections-101618632271968.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
****[[Prime Minister of India|Prime Minister]] [[Narendra Modi]] makes a televised appeal to pilgrims to keep to "symbolic" celebrations and continue to follow safety guidelines as the festival of [[Kumbh Mela]], a pilgrimage traditionally drawing tens of millions of [[Hinduism|Hindu]]s to the banks of the [[Ganges]] every year, begins. [https://english.alarabiya.net/coronavirus/2021/04/17/India-s-Modi-calls-for-limited-Hindu-festivals-as-COVID-19-cases-surge (al-Arabiya English)] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mongolia]]
****[[Mongolia]] surpasses 20,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://www.montsame.mn/en/read/260802 (Montsame)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] surpasses 40,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2101039/two-covid-deaths-1-547-new-cases (''Bangkok Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia]]
***[[Tunisia]] announces the closure of all schools and restrictions on movement, which include a 7:00 p.m. curfew for vehicles, until April 30 to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/article/healthcoronavirus-tunisia-idUSL1N2MA0AB (Reuters)]
**The global [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|death toll]] from COVID-19 surpasses three million. [https://www.npr.org/sections/coronavirus-live-updates/2021/04/17/988386358/global-covid-19-deaths-top-3-million (NPR)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2021 Myanmar coup d'état]]
**A [[Thailand|Thai]] foreign ministry spokesman announces that Burmese [[Junta (governing body)|junta]] leader [[Min Aung Hlaing]] will attend the next [[ASEAN Summit]] on April 24 in [[Jakarta]], [[Indonesia]], thereby marking his first foreign trip since taking power in the February 1 [[Coup d'état|coup]] that deposed [[Aung San Suu Kyi]] and [[Win Myint]]. Local junta spokespeople refused to comment. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210417-myanmar-junta-leader-set-to-join-asean-summit (France 24)]
*[[Foreign relations of the Czech Republic]], [[2014 Vrbětice ammunition warehouses explosions]]
**[[Prime Minister of Czech Republic|Prime Minister]] [[Andrej Babiš]] announces that the [[Czech Republic]] is expelling eighteen [[Embassy of Russia in Prague|Russian embassy]] [[diplomat]]s who have been identified as spies in a case related to an [[ammunition]] warehouse [[explosion]] in 2014. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/04/17/czech-republic-expels-18-russian-embassy-staff-for-spying-in-2014-explosion-case (''Euronews'')]
*[[Foreign relations of Uzbekistan]]
**[[President of Uzbekistan|Uzbekistan President]] [[Shavkat Mirziyoyev]] signs a decree for the [[Uzbekistan|country]] to open a [[List of diplomatic missions of Uzbekistan|diplomatic mission]] in [[Sweden]]. [https://en.trend.az/casia/uzbekistan/3410465.html (Trend)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Rwandan genocide]]
**The [[United States]] [[deport]]s [[Beatrice Munyenyezi]] to [[Rwanda]] after she served her jail term for lying on her [[U.S. citizenship]] naturalization process. Upon arrival in Rwanda, Munyenyezi was arrested on charges ranging from [[murder]] to complicity in [[rape]] during the course of the 1994 [[genocide]]. She did not comment during her arrest to local press but had previously denied the accusations while in the United States. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/rwandan-deported-us-faces-seven-charges-related-genocide-2021-04-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**A court in [[Sicily]] orders former [[Government of Italy|Italian]] [[Italian Minister of the Interior|Interior Minister]] [[Matteo Salvini]] to stand trial accused of [[Dereliction of duty (disambiguation)|dereliction of duty]] and [[kidnapping]] for his role in a standoff with a [[Spain|Spanish]]-flagged [[List of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|migrant rescue ship]] operated by [[Proactiva Open Arms]] that he refused to allow to dock for nineteen days in 2019. A court order allowed the ship to dock after some migrants jumped overboard. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/apr/17/matteo-salvini-trial-standoff-migrant-rescue-ship (''The Guardian'')]
*Myanmar's [[State Administration Council]] [[pardon]]s and releases more than 23,000 prisoners to mark the [[Thingyan|Burmese New Year]]. Those released include an [[Australians|Australian]] businessman sentenced to 13 years in prison for [[drug possession]], and three members of the [[Generation Wave]] pro-democracy movement. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/apr/17/myanmar-junta-pardons-releases-more-than-23000-prisoners (''The Guardian'')]
